title: Date Adder
h1: Date Adder — Add or Subtract Days from a Date
seoTitle: Date Adder — Add Days to Date Free Online
description: Add or subtract any number of days from a starting date to find the resulting calendar date and weekday. Free, private and runs instantly in your browser.
intro: Pick a start date, enter how many days to add or subtract, and see the new date with its weekday. All calculation stays on your device.
blurb: Add or subtract days from any date and see the resulting calendar date and weekday.
howItWorks: Select or enter a starting date.
Enter the number of days to add (use a negative number to go backwards).
Click Calculate to see the new date and its weekday.
examples: A project deadline is 45 days from today — enter today and 45.
Find the date 90 days before a birthday for a reminder.
Calculate the end date of a 14-day free trial.

faq.q: Does it handle leap years and month lengths correctly?
faq.a: Yes. It uses the browser's built-in Date object which correctly accounts for leap years and varying month lengths.
